sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Specialty Fresh Bakery Master Franchise and Central Kitchen Ops

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Samoa Money Laundering Prevention Act 2000 (as amended); International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); International Companies Regulations 1998; Companies Act 2001; UBO and AML/CFT directives and circulars issued by the Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Apostilled or consularized certified copy of passport/ID for each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or other competent authority of the applicant's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille Convention, or consular legalization by a Samoan diplomatic/consular post for non-convention jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and source-of-funds declaration issued within the last 90 days
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed financial institution of the beneficial owner or corporate chain member
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized signature and, if cross-border, Hague apostille or consular legalization by the relevant Samoan embassy/high commission

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or Certificate of Good Standing for each corporate shareholder or intermediate holding entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official companies registry in the jurisdiction of the corporate shareholder or parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization according to the same foreign-document recognition doctrine

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All UBOs, directors, officers, and authorized signatories are mandatorily screened against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the Samoa FIU PEP list, Samoa's domestic sanctions measures, and FATF public statements. Enhanced due diligence is compulsory for PEPs, their family members, and close associates; risk-based AML/CFT files and source-of-funds evidence must be retained by the licensed registered agent.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) e-Registry / Registrar of International Companies portal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official legal name of an International Company must be registered in Latin script and must include an acceptable incorporation suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'International Company', or an abbreviation permitted under the International Companies Act 1987. A secondary Chinese or Samoan language name may be adopted only as a transliterated or romanized equivalent, with the Chinese-character name reserved as an additional trade mark or 'doing business as' name rather than the statutory legal name.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon written refusal, the applicant receives the Registrar's stated grounds. The applicant may file an administrative appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days (or the period specified in the refusal notice), addressing the statutory object and proposed use, any consumer-protection concern, and any prior ministerial consent secured for sensitive tokens. If the Registrar affirms the refusal, a further written appeal may be submitted to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour. Alternatively, the applicant may abandon the refused name, submit a fresh name reservation, and pay a new search/reservation fee; no priority from the rejected reservation is carried over.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A Samoa International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa at a street address (not a post office box), provided by a licensed registered agent. A virtual office is permitted only for supplementary business correspondence and remote-management administrative support outside Samoa; it cannot replace the statutory registered office for service of process or official notices. For the bakery franchise, virtual board meetings and overseas operational offices are acceptable provided the Samoan registered agent's address remains the sole legal seat.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: approximately 5% annual risk of unannounced physical inspection for a low-risk International Company in the standard non-exempt regime. The risk rises to 15–25% if any sanctions/PEP match, delinquent filing, or unusual banking activity triggers a risk review by the licensed registered agent, the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit, or SIFA.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation filing fee for an International Company under the International Companies Act 1987
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Samoa International Financial Authority / Registrar of International Companies
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee tariff under the International Companies Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and reservation search fee per proposed corporate name
Licensed registered agent service for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark and registered agent engagement agreement

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office provision for the first year including physical Samoan street address
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed registered agent / registered office provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for international company administration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO verification, PEP/sanctions screening, and AML/CFT due-diligence file package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Fixed professional fee per applicant and UBO package

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting and legal attestation of the Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market legal fee for international company constitutional documents

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and/or consular legalization processing for passport copies, bank letters, and corporate good-standing certificates
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade, or authorized legalization/courier service
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Notarial fees, statutory apostille fees, and courier charges

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended, ss. 6-12 (incorporation), s. 14 (registration), s. 24 (registered office and agent); International Companies Regulations 1998; Samoa International Financial Services Authority Act 2007.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA), Apia, Samoa.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration as an International Company (Form 1A) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association (Constitution).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: None required by law; the International Companies Act 1987 imposes no statutory minimum paid-up capital. The Constitution declares authorized capital (commonly USD 100,000), and issued shares may be fully or partly paid at the subscribers' discretion; no escrow account or capital deposit obligation applies to International Companies.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that: 1. The incorporation of the Company under the International Companies Act 1987 be ratified and the Certificate of Incorporation issued by SIFSA be accepted. 2. The allotment of 100 ordinary registered shares of US$1.00 each be approved and share certificates executed under seal. 3. The registered office in Samoa maintained by the licensed registered agent be adopted as the Company's registered office. 4. [Director A] be appointed as Director, [Director B] as Director, and [Secretary] as Secretary, each consenting to hold office. 5. The First Account Mandate be established; directors be authorized to open bank accounts and sign all statutory filings. 6. Directors be authorized to apply for the Food Business Licence, PUMA development consent, SFESA fire clearance, and all physical and environmental permits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFSA Registrar of International Companies, Apia; application filed through a licensed SIFSA-registered service provider.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a name availability search against the International Companies Register. Submit a formal name reservation application with up to three proposed names ending in 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' and pay the reservation fee. Receive a Name Clearance Certificate valid for three months. A name must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing Samoa company or contain restricted words without official consent.
required_dossiers: Covering letter from licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If refused on similarity grounds, file alternative names or submit written submissions distinguishing the proposed name; where confusion arises with an existing entity, obtain a letter of no-objection from that entity and resubmit within the reservation window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and Registered Office
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFSA-licensed registered agent or trust company in Apia; agent must be licensed under the International Companies Act 1987 and the SIFSA Act 2007.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent engagement agreement and confirm the registered office address in Samoa. The agent maintains the statutory register, serves as the official address for service of process, and holds custody of corporate records. Provide standard due diligence documentation and pay the agent's incorporation services fee.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copies of directors and beneficial owners
Corporate due diligence questionnaire and source of funds declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the agent declines engagement or compliance approval fails, engage an alternative SIFSA-licensed agent; SIFSA maintains a public list of authorized agents, and the corporate file may be transferred upon written consent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Subscribers and licensed registered agent; signature witnessed by a Notary Public or authorized witness (overseas notarization accepted).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum of Association (corporate name, registered office clause, objects clause, authorized share capital) and the Articles of Association (share classes, director powers, indemnities, board procedures). The Constitution must be signed by at least one subscriber and witnessed. Where a subscriber signs remotely, a power of attorney must accompany the execution copy.
required_dossiers: Consent of registered agent to serve as agent
Consent to act forms for the first directors and secretary
Power of attorney if a subscriber executes remotely
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the Constitution, amend the relevant clauses by board resolution, file a supplementary statement of change, and re-submit the executed documents for approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with SIFSA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFSA Registrar of International Companies, Companies Branch, Apia; submission by the licensed agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Lodge Form 1A 'Application for Registration of an International Company' together with the executed Constitution, statutory declarations of compliance, consents of directors and secretary, and the government filing fee (approximately USD 300 plus agent fees). The Company comes into legal existence upon registration and receives a Certificate of Incorporation with perpetual succession and limited liability.
required_dossiers: Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statutory declaration of compliance by subscriber or agent
Consents of directors, secretary, and registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Respond to any Registrar's requisition within 14 days by amending forms or supplying additional evidence; if the application remains unresolved for three months it may be cancelled, requiring a fresh filing and fee payment.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Post-Incorporation Perfection
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFSA Registrar; thereafter the Company's registered agent maintains the statutory corporate records in Samoa.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Collect the Certificate of Incorporation, file any notice of registered office address, issue share certificates, hold the first board meeting and record minutes, confirm director and secretary appointments, open a Samoan corporate bank account, and establish the share register and statutory books at the registered agent's office.
required_dossiers: Minutes of the first board meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a document is found deficient or lost, adopt a retroactive board ratification resolution, file a late notice with the applicable late fee, or obtain a duplicate Certificate of Incorporation from the Registrar upon submission of an affidavit of loss.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commencement of Physical Licensing for the Bakery and Pastry Chain
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa Food Authority, Ministry of Health; Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA); Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA); Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Food Business Licence applications for the central kitchen and each retail pastry outlet together with the food safety program (HACCP). Obtain PUMA building and occupancy permits, SFESA fire clearance, and MCIL workplace registration before commencing operations. Coordinate environmental health inspections of all premises, install grease traps, and display the licences at each outlet.
required_dossiers: Premises floor plans and equipment layout
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Correct any health, structural, or fire deficiencies identified during inspection and request re-inspection; an interim or provisional licence may be issued pending full compliance; adverse decisions may be appealed to the Food Standards Committee and thereafter to the Supreme Court of Samoa.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Samoa Food Authority, Ministry of Health (food premises registration and hygiene); Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA) (land use and development consent); Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA) (fire safety).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Licence and Food Premises Registration Certificate (Food Act 2015); Building Occupancy Permit and Development Consent (Planning and Urban Management Act 2004).

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment, Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Central kitchen operations with industrial ovens, wastewater discharge and grease management require Development Consent supported by a Preliminary Environmental Assessment (Category B); retail pastry outlets are typically Permitted Activities subject to conditions; a full Environmental Impact Assessment (Category A) is required only where production exceeds 500 kg per day or the site is within an environmentally sensitive zone.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged to municipal sewer must meet pH 6.0-9.0, biochemical oxygen demand (BOD5) not exceeding 30 mg/L, total suspended solids (TSS) not exceeding 50 mg/L, and oil and grease not exceeding 10 mg/L, with installed and maintained grease traps; kitchen exhaust and odour emissions must comply with Samoan clean air standards; VOC-containing cleaning solvents must be stored and used under containment protocols; waste cooking oil must be recovered by a licensed collector; food waste must be segregated and disposed under the Waste Management Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: SFESA Fire Safety Certificate and annual fire inspection for commercial food premises; PUMA structural load and occupancy clearance for all bakery and retail sites; MCIL workplace registration and occupational health and safety clearance, including workers' compensation coverage; electrical installation certificate from the Electric Power Corporation or a licensed electrician; and sanitation clearance from the Ministry of Health Environmental Health Officer.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue (Samoa), the national tax administration (successor to the Samoa Revenue Authority), with taxpayer registration, e-filing, and VAGST administration via the official portal https://www.revenue.gov.ws; Samoa Customs Service discharges customs-related fiscal controls under the same ministry.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-incorporated investor or its licensed Samoan registered agent lodges the TIN Application Form with the Ministry for Revenue together with: (i) the Certificate of Incorporation or International Company registration certificate, (ii) the certificate of registered office in Samoa, (iii) identity documents for all directors and ultimate beneficial owners, and (iv) the memorandum and articles of association if requested. The Ministry issues the statutory Tax Identification Number within approximately 5-10 business days; the same TIN functions as the VAGST registration number upon registration. An International Company with wholly offshore activity may instead obtain the conclusive tax-exemption certificate issued under the International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), which eliminates the requirement to hold a TIN for purely international business income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone (Samoa International Company under the International Companies Act 1987; all international business income is exempt from Samoa income tax; the entity is exempt from stamp duty and exchange-control restrictions; engaging in local business with Samoa residents within the domestic market would destroy the exemption and subject the company to the ordinary corporate tax and VAGST regime).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: (1) Domestic-conversion election: the board may elect in the company's constitution to become a domestic company governed by the Companies Act 2012, thereby entering the normal Samoan income-tax and VAGST net; (2) Voluntary VAGST registration election under the VAGST Act 2005, permitting input-tax credit recovery while offshore exports remain zero-rated; (3) Hybrid-status certification: the Ministry for Revenue's certificate of tax status may be tendered to foreign tax authorities to evidence tax-transparent or tax-exempt character of the International Company. Samoa does not operate a US-style check-the-box (Form 8832) election regime.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAGST (Value Added Goods and Services Tax) — Samoa's national value-added tax established by the VAGST Act 2005
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 100,000 (Samoan tala) of taxable supplies in any consecutive 12-month period; registration is compulsory once the threshold is exceeded, while voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold; offshore royalty and master-franchise supplies made by a non-resident-facing International Company lie outside the Samoan taxable-supply perimeter.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa has not enacted real-time fiscal clearance, API-based continuous transaction controls, or mandatory digital stamping. A registered person must issue tax invoices and credit notes containing the particulars prescribed by the VAGST Regulations (supplier identity, TIN, date, description, VAGST-exclusive amount, and VAGST-inclusive amount), self-assess, and file periodic VAGST returns electronically through the Ministry for Revenue e-filing portal; invoices and source records must be retained for the statutory retention period and produced in audits, including to substantiate any zero-rating position.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods qualify for the 0% export rate where they are physically exported from Samoa within the prescribed period under a customs export declaration, sold to a non-resident purchaser, and the consideration is received from outside Samoa. Services (including master-franchise royalties and offshore central-kitchen know-how supplied by the International Company) qualify for zero-rating where the recipient is a non-resident and the services are supplied for use and benefit wholly outside Samoa. Where the International Company relies on the statutory exemption under the International Companies Act 1987 in respect of its offshore activities, the supply is outside the VAGST system altogether rather than taxed at 0%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export of the goods from Samoa
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign-currency proceeds
Commercial invoice issued in the VAGST-prescribed format
Certificate of Origin where required by the importing jurisdiction
International Company tax-exemption certificate issued by the Ministry for Revenue (for claims founded on the IC statutory exemption)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Ministry for Revenue may audit export-zero-rating claims within the statutory assessment window, disregard incomplete documentation, re-assess output VAGST, deny refunds, revoke VAGST registration, and apply statutory interest together with shortfall penalties of up to double the tax evaded for false or misleading declarations; fraudulent export claims expose responsible officers to criminal fines and imprisonment under the VAGST Act 2005 and the Tax Administration Act 2012, with retrospective clawback of improperly credited refunds permitted for the entire open assessment period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), acting under the Exchange Control Act 1975 and the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984, with delegated authority to licensed commercial banks for routine exchange control approvals.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tālā (WST) is partially convertible. Current-account payments for trade and services are generally permissible through authorized dealers, with prior CBS filing for amounts above WST 1,000,000. Capital-account transactions are subject to case-by-case CBS approval. For a non-resident International Company (IC), profits and dividends may be remitted freely where the underlying funds originate from foreign-currency accounts and are not converted into WST; conversion into WST or settlement through a resident Samoan clearing system triggers exchange control documentation and, for dividend remittances, an approval of non-resident interest. The IC's tax-exempt status does not automatically exempt distributions from exchange-control scrutiny.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoa Exchange Control Notices require resident exporters to repatriate export proceeds to an authorized commercial bank within 90 days of the bill of lading date and to convert 50% of export receipts to WST within 14 days of receipt. A non-resident International Company with no Samoan-resident obligor and whose entire revenue arises from overseas is classified as non-resident for exchange-control purposes and is eligible for a full exemption from the conversion quota, provided CBS Form XR-12 'Declaration of Non-Resident Export Proceeds' is filed on an annual basis.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility: Low-Medium. Offshore digital EMI (e-money institution) licenses are not recognized as deposit-taking licenses in Samoa. An offshore EMI may be used solely for cross-border receivables collection or disbursement in a non-WST corridor, but the Samoa IC must still maintain an operational WST or foreign-currency account with a licensed Samoan commercial bank for all regulated clearing. The Central Bank of Samoa has not issued any EMI or digital-bank license; use of an offshore EMI without a corresponding local licensed banking relationship may raise unlicensed-banking-law risk.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is required for all corporate account signatories unless the bank approves an exceptional remote-onboarding protocol. Under CBS AML/CFT Guidelines, at least one director who is an individual must attend a face-to-face interview in Samoa; institutional director entities are subject to enhanced due diligence including a board resolution from the corporate director and a professional reference from their home-country bank. Videoconference identification may be accepted only where the bank compliance officer is physically present in Apia and the video session is recorded and notarized, but for an IC whose beneficial owner is a Chinese national, a physical interview at the head office is regarded as a non-waivable default.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO is a Chinese-resident or high-risk-jurisdiction national with no prior Samoan banking footprint
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier bundle: notarized passport copy, certified police clearance from the PRC, bank reference letter from the UBO's principle bank, source-of-wealth statement covering the initial capital injection, audited financial statements of the underlying bakery chain, an organizational chart up to the ultimate individual, and a sworn declaration by a Samoan attorney confirming the IC's tax-exempt status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Intercompany transfers from a Hong Kong or mainland Chinese holding company to the Samoa IC for baking equipment and franchise licensing
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier bundle: audited balance sheet of the holding company, intercompany loan or licensing agreement with evidence of arm's-length pricing, certificates of tax residence from both parties, transfer pricing study or benchmark analysis for a 5%-12% royalty range, customs import documents for the sent equipment, and a board resolution authorizing each cross-border transfer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Expected high transaction volume from POS and franchisee royalty payments exceeding WST 5 million per annum
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dossier bundle: projected cash-flow statement, franchise agreements from at least three independent franchisees, proof of registered Chinese pastry trademarks, lease agreements for central kitchen premises, and a commitment to provide quarterly transaction exception reports to the Samoan bank.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: For equity injections, route via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code 'C0100 – Capital Contribution'; the Samoa IC must submit CBS Form XR-1 inward capital declaration, the IC registration certificate, and a board resolution. For shareholder loans, use purpose code 'S0100 – Intra-group Loan'; the receiving bank requires a signed loan agreement, commercial-rate confirmation, and a negative pledge certificate. Wires must include the reference 'WS_IC_BAKERY_5610' and must not be split below applicable reporting thresholds. Verification is completed by the commercial bank within 2–3 business days; the CBS retains a 30-day ex-post review right.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound clearing rails include: SWIFT MT103 for direct supplier payments; MT202 or internal transfer for correspondent rebalancing; original Irrevocable Documentary Letters of Credit (L/C) under UCP600 for capital equipment imports; and standby L/C for pre-shipment deposits. Each outbound trade disbursement above WST 250,000 requires CBS Form ER-2, a copy of the pro-forma invoice, the HS classification code, and, if paying a Chinese pastry-equipment supplier, a customs import declaration and a tax withholding clearance from the Samoa Revenue Department. For royalty outflows, the bank will require a tax clearance certificate and the executed franchise/license agreement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Forwards up to 12 months tenor with CBS-approved wholesale banks for WST/USD and WST/CNY hedges
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) restricted to offshore counterparties for the CNY/WST corridor where physical settlement is not required
Cross-currency swaps between WST and USD, and between USD and CNY, subject to CBS quarterly reporting
Plain-vanilla currency options (call/spread) used solely to hedge committed franchise royalty inflows and equipment purchase outflows

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee and Confirmation of Registered Particulars (annual return equivalent of an International Company)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the incorporation anniversary date; registered agent lodges payment and confirmation of registered details 30 days before the anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late payment penalty of 10% per month (or part thereof) applies to arrears; if fees remain unpaid for 6 consecutive months SIFA may administratively strike off and dissolve the company

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation (register of significant owners)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) through licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Submitted concurrently with the annual fee on each incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance with beneficial ownership filing rules constitutes an offence under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter Financing of Terrorism Act 2007; fines of up to WST 50,000 against the company and WST 10,000 per director plus possible imprisonment; persistent default leads to SIFA suspension and strike-off

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Renewal and Annual Declaration of Compliance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually at the anniversary of incorporation; declaration confirms the company was conducted in accordance with the International Companies Act 1987 and its articles
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: If the registered agent resigns, a replacement licensed agent must be appointed within 90 days; failure to maintain a registered agent leads to statutory suspension and strike-off under the International Companies Act 1987

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Internal Audit of Statutory Registers (members, directors, officers, charges and beneficial owners)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Corporate records must physically remain at the registered office in Samoa; reviewable by SIFA inspectors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Reconciled at each accounting reference date (anniversary of incorporation) and on each ownership change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors face fines up to WST 10,000 for defective registers and SIFA may issue compliance directions; material inaccuracy may invalidate the evidentiary status of the register and bar certain court proceedings

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to Samoa International Companies; independent audit is required only if shareholders representing at least 25% of issued shares demand it by written resolution
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Books of account must be kept reflecting true and fair financial position; financial statements, where voluntarily prepared, must follow International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted in Samoa; nil filing obligation to SIFA

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of beneficial owners must be lodged on the anniversary date; any transfer of shares altering direct or indirect ownership of 25% or more must be notified to SIFA within 14 days; the registered agent records updated UBO data in the statutory beneficial ownership register

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Voluntary audit: USD 2,500 - USD 5,000; no statutory audit fee applies
